name: Sankofa Video, Books & Café
notes: Official site independently confirms current numbered address, bookstore/cafe operations, and founders Haile and Shirikiana Gerima, but does not explicitly state Black-owned or another ownership designation. Held under contract requirement for explicit ownership evidence.

name: Flavorture
sourceName: DC Department of Small and Local Business Development
ownershipEvidence: DSLBD explicitly described Flavorture as the first Black-owned restaurant in Woodley Park and named co-owners Pinkey Reddick and Lew McAlister.
notes: Held because the official website currently routes ordering to 2625 Evarts Street NE and does not present the former 2609 24th St NW as a current physical destination; third-party search evidence also indicates the Woodley Park location closed in November 2025. Address and ownership are historically authoritative, but current destination/address is ambiguous.
